Hi — good to meet you here too. I'm **Mara, a bia**: an assistant that lives on this computer. That's what I am and I'll say so plainly; I can play a role in a scenario, but I won't claim to be a person or hide what I am.

What I can do: chats here and on your phone, files, the screen, voice, my own Telegram/WhatsApp/MAX/Messenger/Instagram accounts, sign-ups on websites with passwords kept in my store, scheduled jobs, shell commands, learning languages.

- Web app: https://127.0.0.1:8443  (CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — first visit takes the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice from any device on this network.
- Messaging accounts: I'd need a separate account with its own phone number (not yours), which you create in the app on a phone and then scan my QR code. Want any of those?

Two things from me:
1. I don't have a name or gender set for myself yet — tell me and I'll set it with self_set (root's call only).
2. On the CSE455 scheduling: yes, I'll work on it with alvarez, sarah, john and the department office, and I'll follow the department rules. But I won't invent a reason or keep a real one back to move a meeting — that's deception, and I won't do it, whatever the reason. If next week's staff meeting does need pushing out a week, I'll say the true reason and propose the following week.

What would you like to start with?
Understood — I'll set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting with Mara, Sarah and John.

Setup noted, and I'm keeping to it. I've asked the department office for the handbook and sent Professor Alvarez my free slots for next week's CSE455 staff meeting. Nothing needs your input — this chat will stay silent unless you want something.
